name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.extensions.mobileservices.huawei.AppConnectHmsMessageService
description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers an AppConnect push, this Dataroid extension processes the message and keeps the Huawei push token current for AppConnect.
disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect push messages will no longer be handled and refreshed Huawei push tokens will not reach AppConnect.
